attr.title: Ekron Realms
attr.desc: An urban sandbox city on the Realms engine, a Free Pascal port of the Quake 2 stack. Explore the city, drive and fly a drone, or play Quake 2 maps with your own data.
attr.inst: Ready to run: the city needs no extra files. For Quake 2 maps, copy pak0.pak (and pak1.pak, pak2.pak) from your Quake 2 baseq2 folder into ports/ekronrealms/baseq2, then start Ekron Realms - Quake 2.
